basic_details.short_information: The NCL recruitment 2026 is an engagement of interns for FY 2026-27 under the Prime Minister Internship Scheme, covering 52 unfilled vacancies across technical and non-technical disciplines. Notification No. NCL/HRD/Apprentice-PMIS/2026-27/890 was issued by the HRD Department of NCL on 19 November 2026. The official notification does not specify the application fee.

salary_details.details: The stipend is credited directly to the intern's Aadhaar-linked bank account, and no deduction for social security benefits will be made. No additional medical benefits will be provided by NCL, and no TA/DA is paid for attending document scrutiny or joining formalities.

selection_process: Merit list: prepared by arranging the aggregate scores of the qualifying examinations (Degree/Diploma) in descending order for each discipline. Tie-breaking: a candidate older in age (earlier date of birth) is preferred; if a tie persists

the candidate whose name appears first alphabetically in English (Roman script) is preferred. Document verification: shortlisted candidates will be notified via the PMIS portal and the NCL official website.
The notice mentions no written examination or interview for this engagement. Before joining
selected candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate in the prescribed format from a Government Medical Officer.
how_to_apply: Make sure you have a valid email ID, a mobile number and an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
Go to the centralized PMIS portal, www.pminternship.mca.gov.in, between 21 November 2026 and 6 December 2026.
Complete the online registration on the PMIS portal and apply for the NCL internship.
Do not send a paper or hard copy application; such applications will not be accepted.
For technical issues while applying through the portal, email the NCL HRD Department at [email protected].
important_instructions: The internship training under PMIS lasts 09 months from the date of engagement. The engagement does not lead to any claim for regular employment in NCL or CIL, and interns will not be absorbed into regular service of NCL or CIL under any circumstances. Interns must make their own arrangements for accommodation, food and transport during the training period. Leave entitlements are governed by the applicable PMIS guidelines. Suppression of facts or submission of false certificates will lead to immediate cancellation of candidature. Regular updates are posted on the official NCL website under Menu>Career>Apprenticeship Training. NCL HRD Department contact on the letterhead: Phone 07805- 256405, email [email protected].

Clerk; Office Assistant/ Graduate Assistant; Lab Technician
B.Com (Clerk), BA (Office Assistant/ Graduate Assistant), B. Sc in Chemistry (Lab Technician)
Minimum 18 years and Maximum 25 years as on 1 December 2026
Online only, through the PMIS portal
Merit list of aggregate scores in the qualifying examination, followed by document verification
09 months from the date of engagement

content_sections.heading: About NCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Northern Coalfields Limited is a listed Public Undertaking and a subsidiary of Coal India Limited under the Ministry of Coal, Government of India, with its headquarters at Post- Singrauli Colliery, Distt: Singrauli, M.P., PIN 486889. The notice states that NCL scaled up to 140.50 MT of coal production. This internship engagement is part of the national skill development initiative and is run by the HRD Department, with the notice signed by the General Manager (HRD), CETI, NCL HQ, Singrauli.

content_sections.heading: NCL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: As of 19 November 2026, the online application window has not yet opened; it opens on 21 November 2026. The notice gives no date for the merit list or document verification.

content_sections.heading: NCL Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NCL has notified 52 balance / unfulfilled vacancies (Round 3 target) under PMIS, split across three designations as below. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of these vacancies.

content_sections.heading: NCL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed and passed the prescribed qualification from a recognised Institute/University functional as of the crucial date. Eligibility for qualification is assessed with respect to 1 December 2026, unless specified otherwise. Before completing online registration on the PMIS portal, applicants must have a valid email ID, a mobile number and an Aadhaar-linked bank account. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: NCL Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for all three NCL intern designations is minimum 18 years and maximum 25 years as on the crucial date, 1 December 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: NCL Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The stipend is credited directly to the intern's Aadhaar-linked bank account, and no deduction for social security benefits will be made. No additional medical benefits will be provided by NCL, and no TA/DA is paid for attending document scrutiny or joining formalities.

content_sections.heading: NCL Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Merit list: prepared by arranging the aggregate scores of the qualifying examinations (Degree/Diploma) in descending order for each discipline. Tie-breaking: a candidate older in age (earlier date of birth) is preferred; if a tie persists, the candidate whose name appears first alphabetically in English (Roman script) is preferred. Document verification: shortlisted candidates will be notified via the PMIS portal and the NCL official website. The notice mentions no written examination or interview for this engagement. Before joining, selected candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate in the prescribed format from a Government Medical Officer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Make sure you have a valid email ID, a mobile number and an Aadhaar-linked bank account. Go to the centralized PMIS portal, www.pminternship.mca.gov.in , between 21 November 2026 and 6 December 2026. Complete the online registration on the PMIS portal and apply for the NCL internship. Do not send a paper or hard copy application; such applications will not be accepted. For technical issues while applying through the portal, email the NCL HRD Department at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: NCL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The internship training under PMIS lasts 09 months from the date of engagement. The engagement does not lead to any claim for regular employment in NCL or CIL, and interns will not be absorbed into regular service of NCL or CIL under any circumstances. Interns must make their own arrangements for accommodation, food and transport during the training period. Leave entitlements are governed by the applicable PMIS guidelines. Suppression of facts or submission of false certificates will lead to immediate cancellation of candidature. Regular updates are posted on the official NCL website under Menu>Career>Apprenticeship Training. NCL HRD Department contact on the letterhead: Phone 07805- 256405, email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NCL has 52 intern vacancies under PMIS: 30 Clerk, 17 Office Assistant/ Graduate Assistant and 5 Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q2. When does the NCL PMIS internship application start?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 21 November 2026 on the PMIS portal, www.pminternship.mca.gov.in.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the NCL internship 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NCL PMIS internship?
faq.answer: Candidates must be minimum 18 years and maximum 25 years old as on 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Clerk needs B.Com, Office Assistant/ Graduate Assistant needs BA, and Lab Technician needs B. Sc in Chemistry, completed and passed from a recognised Institute/University as of 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for NCL interns?
faq.answer: All three designations get a monthly stipend of ₹9,000/-, credited directly to the intern's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

faq.question: Q7. How will NCL select the interns?
faq.answer: NCL will prepare a merit list of aggregate scores in the qualifying examination (Degree/Diploma) for each discipline; ties go to the older candidate and then alphabetically, and shortlisted candidates are called for document verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NCL PMIS internship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The internship lasts 09 months from the date of engagement and interns will not be absorbed into regular service of NCL or CIL under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q9. Will NCL pay TA/DA for document verification?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending document scrutiny or joining formalities.

faq.question: Q10. Is a medical certificate required for joining the NCL internship?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate in the prescribed format from a Government Medical Officer before joining.
